partnership_proposal.title: PROPOSAL FOR STRATEGIC FULFILLMENT PARTNERSHIP
body: We are writing to propose a strategic partnership between {{COMPANY_NAME}} and [Pharmacy Name].
The Invisible Customer:

Every day, young people walk past your pharmacy, needing HIV tests or contraceptives, but they don't come in. Why? Because they are terrified of being seen. With 15,290 new HIV infections last year and 60% of users preferring confidential testing, this stigma is blocking millions in sales.
The Solution: We Bring Them to You.
DiscreetKit is the digital bridge. We let customers order anonymously online, and we route those orders directly to you. We are the 'Uber for Privacy.'
Partnership Benefits:
• New Revenue Stream: We capture the 635,000+ tertiary students who are currently too shy to buy. You get the sale; we handle the customer.
• Zero Logistics: Our unbranded riders handle the pickup and delivery. You just pack the item.
• Future-Proof: The Govt is rolling out vending machines to fight stigma. Partnering with us puts your pharmacy ahead of the curve.
We would welcome the opportunity to discuss a commission structure.

investor_brief.title: DISCREETKIT: THE 12.7M GHS OPPORTUNITY
body: The Moment of Dread:

Imagine walking into a quiet pharmacy. You ask for an HIV test. Heads turn. The silence is deafening. That single moment of shame is friction. And right now, that friction is blocking millions in healthcare transactions.
The 12.7 Million GHS Math:

Ghana has 635,000 tertiary students. They are young, sexually active, and live on their phones. If we capture just 20% of this market buying 2 discreet kits a year, that is GHS 12.7 Million in revenue.
Why We Win (The Moat):

Competitors focus on medicine delivery; we focus on dignity. With 334,000+ HIV cases and 40% undiagnosed due to fear, the market is screaming for privacy. The Govt is validating us by rolling out vending machines—we are the scalable, digital version of that solution.
The Model:
• Asset-Light: We partner with pharmacies. Zero inventory cost.
• High Trust: 100% unbranded delivery means 80%+ retention.
• Team: Built by students, for students. Roots in Tech, Law, and Business.
The Ask:
We are raising [Investment Amount] to dominate the Accra campus market. We have the tech. We have the team. We just need the fuel.

contributor_charter.title: ACCESS DISCREETKIT LTD CONTRIBUTOR ENGAGEMENT CHARTER & NDA
body: 1. THE MISSION

You are joining DiscreetKit at its most critical stage: Day One. We are not just building a delivery service; we are building a privacy infrastructure for health in Ghana. We exist to remove the embarrassment, judgment, and stigma that stops people from getting the care they need. By signing this, you are joining a team that values Speed, Privacy, and Empathy above all else.
2. THE RELATIONSHIP

You are joining us as a Voluntary Contributor. We are currently a pre-revenue, bootstrapped startup. This means there is no fixed salary right now. Instead, we offer a platform for you to build high-impact work, gain direct operational experience, and be part of our founding story.
The Value Exchange (What You Get):
• Portfolio Rights: You have the explicit right to showcase the work you create here in your personal portfolio (once the product is public).
• First Right of Hire: As we scale and raise capital, active Contributors get first priority for paid full-time roles.
• Reference & Reputation: The Founders commit to providing detailed, high-level recommendations and referrals for your future career steps.
• Commissions: Specific roles (like sales/growth) may be eligible for performance-based commissions as defined in separate memos.
3. THE CODE OF SILENCE (Confidentiality)
We deal with sexual health. Privacy is our product.

• User Data is Sacred: You may never, under any circumstances, share, save, or discuss customer data (names, locations, orders). A breach here is not just a firing offense; it is a legal one under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).
• Trade Secrets: Our strategy, partner lists, code, and unreleased designs are confidential. Keep them inside the Circle.
4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY (Who Owns What)
To build a company that can scale and protect itself, the company must own what it creates.
Assignment: Any code, design, copy, or strategy you create specifically for DiscreetKit belongs to Access Discreetkit Ltd.
Why? Investors and partners require us to have clean ownership of our tech and brand. This protects the platform you are helping to build.
5. THE "NO HARD FEELINGS" CLAUSE
We respect your time and freedom.
• Leaving: You can step back at any time. We just ask for a quick heads-up so we can hand over your tasks.
• Removal: We reserve the right to remove contributors who are inactive or violate our values (especially regarding privacy).
6. ACCEPTANCE
I understand that I am contributing to build something meaningful. I agree to keep DiscreetKit’s secrets safe and assign the rights to my contributions to the company.

sections.heading: Business Summary
sections.content: Access Discreetkit Ltd is a Ghanaian health-tech company building the privacy layer for healthcare delivery. We enable young adults to access sensitive reproductive health products without fear, judgment, or stigma. Incorporated under the Companies Act, 2019 (Act 992).

sections.heading: Mission
sections.content: To remove the social barriers to healthcare by providing a dignified, anonymous, and fast access route to essential products.

sections.heading: Market Opportunity
sections.content: The consumer health market is losing revenue to stigma. With 15,290 new HIV infections recorded in 2024 and over 334,000 people living with HIV in Ghana, the need for testing is critical. However, social embarrassment prevents thousands from entering pharmacies. Government data confirms that 60% of users prefer confidential testing. We capture this 'hidden' market.

sections.heading: What We Do
sections.content: We operate a digital ordering platform for HIV Self-Test Kits, Pregnancy Test Kits, Emergency Contraceptives, Condoms, and Intimate Care products.

sections.heading: How We Operate
sections.content:
• No Inventory Risk: We partner with licensed pharmacies to hold stock.
• Tech-Enabled: Orders are routed via our secure platform.
• Anonymous Logistics: Delivery is handled by unbranded riders in plain packaging.
